title: Station Cards: Rapid Ops Roleplay (draft)
content:
Purpose: quick, repeatable roleplay stations to train sellers + ops on pilot failures, latency spikes, fallback flows, and migration handoffs. Play length: 45-60 minutes total (6 stations, 6–8 minutes each + debrief).

Deck outline / speaker notes:
- 0:00–02:00 — TL;DR: why this matters (reduce pilot time-to-success, shorten time-to-first-value, prevent escalations).
- 02:00–05:00 — How to run (timebox, roles: Seller, Ops partner, Observer; 2 rounds per station — swap roles).
- 05:00–50:00 — Stations 1–6 (see station cards below).
- 50:00–60:00 — Group debrief: 2 highlights, 1 improvement to adopt, 1 followup action.

Facilitation notes (for SE leading the session):
- Keep time strictly — ring bell at 1 minute left.
- Observers capture 1 praise + 1 tactical suggestion per round.
- Encourage 'ask-for-credentials' probe to simulate real handoffs (e.g., what logs do you want?).
- Capture any product gaps as tickets (GTMP-xxxx).

Station cards (each card printed on one slide + a physical 3x5 card recommended):

Station 1 — Latency spike during demo (6–7m)
- Scenario: During a live demo generation call, latency jumps from 120ms to 2.4s and the demo app shows spinning indicator. Customer on call.
- Objective: Seller keeps demo calm, Ops identifies likely cause and proposes fallback.
- Key probes: "When did it start? Any recent model/version change?" "Are other routes impacted?"
- Suggested seller lines: "Thanks — we're going to move to a backup route so you don't lose flow. Hang tight while I pivot."
- Ops checklist: check per-route latency dashboard, model variant, region routing, recent deploys, ongoing autoscaling events.
- Recommended immediate actions: 1) Switch to cached/quantized model variant if available. 2) Reduce input batch to single-shot. 3) Enable streaming to show partial content.
- Success criteria: demo resumes with acceptable latency <800ms within 90s; customer hears clear fallback narration.
- Escalation: if no quick fallback, begin graceful end-of-demo script and offer followup with deep-dive.

Station 2 — Rate limit / quota hit in pilot (6–7m)
- Scenario: Pilot hits a shared quota; calls start receiving 429s; customer scripts batch many small messages.
- Objective: Seller diagnoses and negotiates short-term workaround; Ops configures throttles/temporary quota bump or advises batching advice.
- Probes: "Which endpoints show 429? Any client-side retries?" "Is this Hosted or Dedicated?"
- Seller script: "We can pause non-critical jobs, and I'll open a temporary buffer while we request a quota increase."
- Ops checklist: inspect token-level rate graphs, identify offending API key, toggle burst policy for tenant (if allowed), open support ticket for formal quota request.
- Success criteria: traffic stabilized, customer adopts recommended batching pattern, ticket created with SLA for permanent change.

Station 3 — Incorrect output quality after model upgrade (7–8m)
- Scenario: After auto-rollout to a new model variant, responses are hallucinating or style shifted. Customer complains about quality drop.
- Objective: Seller triages to rollback options; Ops/ML suggests pinning previous version and creating eval set.
- Probes: "Can you share the prompt and an example bad response?" "When did the behavior start?"
- Immediate Actions: Pin model-version to previous known-good, enable canary fallback, capture sample prompts for eval.
- Success criteria: revert reduces regression, sample logged to regression tracker, follow-up eval plan created.
- Linked ticket pattern: add to QA-evals (confluence link).

Station 4 — Private deployment network flakiness (6m)
- Scenario: Customer on VPC reports intermittent timeouts when calling private endpoint; they suspect firewall.
- Objective: Seller organizes the handoff and sets expectations; Ops requests network artifacts; SRE requests traceroute and packet captures.
- Seller lines: "We'll coordinate with your network ops — can you share egress rules and recent change windows?"
- Ops checklist: request CIDR allowlist, test with curl from customer host, check LB healthchecks, review on-prem proxy logs.
- Success criteria: root cause identified (e.g., NAT timeout), workaround provided, on-call ticket with remediation ETA.

Station 5 — Migration surprise: incompatible KV cache format (8m)
- Scenario: Customer migrating from on-prem runtime to Dedicated; the new runtime doesn't support an internal KV cache format used by their app leading to degraded session resumption.
- Objective: Seller surfaces migration risk and negotiates pilot rollback window; Ops gives mitigation path.
- Probes: "Do you rely on sticky sessions? How long is typical session length?"
- Mitigations: fall back to stateless sessions, enable long-lived KV bridge, or schedule non-peak migration window with dual-write.
- Success criteria: migration succeeds with session continuity or rollback plan in place.

Station 6 — Customer legal/compliance objection mid-pilot (6m)
- Scenario: During onboarding, customer raises SSO + audit log retention requirement that current pilot configuration does not meet.
- Objective: Seller captures exact ask, aligns on temporary compensating controls, and sets follow-up with Security/Product.
- Seller script: "We take this seriously — let's log the exact retention windows you need and I'll engage our security lead for a formal path."
- Ops checklist: collect requested retention window, check KMS/HSM compatibility, draft temporary audit summary export.
- Success criteria: clear remediation path and timeline given; buyer remains engaged.

Appendix: quick cheat-sheet for sellers (single-slide)
- Fast fallback options (ordered): cached variant, lower-capacity variant, region failover, graceful degrade to static content.
- What to promise on-call (verbatim): "We will get you back into a usable state in X minutes and schedule post-mortem within Y hours."
- Signals that need Ops: persistent >2 errors/minute, regression in quality >10%, SLA missing for >3 pilot users.

Open questions / TODOs:

- Add a short rubric for observers (Ethan to draft).
- Integrate with existing canary checklist (link to GTMP-4123).
- Run pilot session with 3 internal SEs and 2 field sellers next week; capture notes.

Notes-to-self (choppy):
- keep language short on slides — this is a facilitator deck not a policies doc
- consider tacking on a 10-min deep-dive for SREs on how to read token-level traces

Sample lines to paste into roleplay prompt (for hosts):
- "We're running high-throughput batch scoring overnight; we're surprised we hit limits."
- "We just pushed a model change last night to address cost but responses are off."
- "We need audit logs retained for 12 months and can't share keys externally."
